title: Tag-aware memory retention
codebase_type: Python memory service with a decay engine, a maintenance facade and administrative HTTP routes
change_scope: Four production modules add tag-specific decay policy to scoring, public maintenance methods, input schemas and HTTP administration.
testing_approach: The regression suite exercises the public maintenance facade and an in-process HTTP test client. It checks policy round trips, invalid updates, first-match tag precedence, score and decay behavior, zero-rate preservation, administrative create/list/delete paths, reinforcement and unchanged defaults.
attribution: Original memory-service code: Mars375 and contributors. Portfolio feature reference patch, task adaptation and regression tests: Saketh Thumuluri, with AI assistance.
